issues.explanation: No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change despite new models, policies, middleware, routes and Livewire components requiring happy-path plus unauthorized/tamper coverage.
Entity creation performs a two-table transactional domain write directly in the Livewire component instead of an app/Actions/* use-case class that authorizes inside the action.
Custom current_entity middleware is aliased for Livewire routes but never registered via Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware, so it silently stops applying on Livewire update requests.
Entity picker and tenant middleware authorize with manual membershipFor null checks instead of going through Entity/EntityMembership policies or gates.

Livewire update requests bypass current_entity tenant resolution for the same reason, leaving only mount-time authorization on a component with no further actions; limited impact here but violates the Livewire security policy.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:130 writes via DB::transaction in component, not app/Actions/*; bootstrap/app.php:58 aliases current_entity without Livewire::addPersistentMiddleware; routes/web.php:955 and EnsureCurrentEntity.php:46 use manual membershipFor checks instead of policies

readability.evidence: app/Models/Entity.php:52, app/Policies/EntityPolicy.php:40, app/Livewire/Entity/CreateEntity.php:99 small focused methods and clear names consistent with Laravel style; no dead code

requirements.evidence: database/migrations/2026_10_29_060432*: entities_slug_unique with soft deletes; 2026_10_29_060433*: owner_seq storedAs plus entity_memberships_one_owner; CreateEntity.php:113 #[Validate], :127 uniqueSlug per attempt, :145 retry on unique violation, :152 audit log; routes/web.php:944,946,952,969 plus EnsureCurrentEntity.php:36 dispatch; Dashboard.php:216 authorize view

scope.evidence: change.diff touches only entities/memberships, onboarding, session, switcher, dashboard, lang, docs/database-schema.md and CHANGELOG.md; no members/settings pages, invitations, or locale-middleware changes

security.evidence: CreateEntity.php:113 validated name plus :120 authorize create and server-set UserRole::Owner; Dashboard.php:216 authorize view; switcher.blade.php uses {{ }} only; fillables in Entity.php:250 and EntityMembership.php:306 exclude owner_seq; pick route aborts 403 before touching session

simplicity.evidence: EnsureCurrentEntity.php:85 setTenantContext helper, CreateEntity.php:162 uniqueSlug loop, Entity.php:280 owner HasOne query reuse Eloquent instead of new abstractions

tests.evidence: change.diff contains no tests/ files; factories and migrations ship without Pest feature tests for onboarding retry, pick 403, middleware dispatch, policy rules, or Livewire unauthorized/tamper cases

review.summary: The change implements the full entities data model, policies, onboarding with slug retry, tenant middleware, switcher, picker and dashboard per the contract. It is blocked by missing Pest tests and Livewire persistent-middleware plus Action-layer convention gaps, so it needs substantial rework before merge.
